visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a Japanese restaurant interior. Customers, including several women with their hair tied back, sit on high stools at a long wooden counter. The decor features wood-paneled walls, warm lanterns, and posters. (2) A top-down close-up shows a wooden tray containing two small plates of grilled rolls, a pot of tea, and a bowl of miso soup. (3) A close-up reveals a donburi rice bowl topped with salmon, beef, and roe; a hand picks up a piece of nigiri sushi from a nearby plate. (4) An extreme close-up features a grilled zucchini roll being held with chopsticks, glistening with sauce against a white plate background. (5) A series of extreme close-ups follow, showing a seared scallop topped with ikura, a thick slice of raw salmon, and a piece of grilled beef with garnishes. (6) A wooden spoon scoops up a mouthful of seasoned rice topped with glistening orange salmon roe. (7) A small rectangular dish of fruit salad with a bright yellow dressing is shown in a close-up. (8) A spoon lifts a large clam and pieces of tofu from a dark bowl of miso soup. (9) A chef in a blue uniform is shown slicing a piece of raw fish on a yellow cutting board with a long, sharp knife. (10) The chef's hands place a piece of sushi on a plate already filled with various nigiri varieties. (11) Several close-up shots showcase different sushi: an 'Angel Red Shrimp', a seared scallop, and a piece of yellowtail. (12) The chef is seen peeling a zucchini into long strips, then rolling it with meat on a wooden board. (13) Two skewers of shrimp wrapped in pork are held up, showing a charred, glazed texture. (14) A lid is lifted from a ceramic pot to reveal steamed clams in a light broth. (15) A final wide shot shows the restaurant interior from the entrance, with a server standing behind the counter. (16) The video ends with a shot of the restaurant's wooden storefront with a white sign displaying the name and address.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 高雄巷弄裡的這間. (2) [Subtitle]: 日式小店. (3) [Subtitle]: 有好吃的丼飯和握壽司. (4) [Subtitle]: 烤物料理也很受歡迎. (5) [Subtitle]: 你們一定要試試炙燒三味丼. (6) [Subtitle]: 一次品嚐干貝、鮭魚、牛肉三種美味. (7) [Subtitle]: 還吃得到甜甜的玉子燒. (8) [Subtitle]: 搭配拌入香鬆、香菇的醋飯. (9) [Subtitle]: 口感很豐富. (10) [Subtitle]: 附餐有開胃的小菜. (11) [Subtitle]: 蛤蜊豆腐味噌湯. (12) [Subtitle]: 想吃壽司的話. (13) [Subtitle]: 推薦點九貫握壽司. (14) [Subtitle]: 依每日新鮮魚貨搭配. (15) [Subtitle]: 可選擇生食或炙燒. (16) [Subtitle]: 這次我們吃到的有天使紅蝦. (17) [Subtitle]: 炙燒干貝、鰤魚. (18) [Subtitle]: 多款新鮮魚料. (19) [Subtitle]: 口感都細緻鮮美. (20) [Subtitle]: 這個烤櫛瓜牛肉捲一定要點. (21) [Subtitle]: 現點現做、脆爽多汁. (22) [Subtitle]: 還有甘醇醬香味. (23) [Subtitle]: 再來一份豬肉包蝦子的草豚捲. (24) [Subtitle]: 搭配熱騰騰上桌的酒蒸蛤蜊. (25) [Subtitle]: 這裡座位不多、建議先訂位. (26) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (27) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉. (28) [Slogan]: 樂壽司 樂すし 高雄市前金區光復三街77-1號.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote '樂壽司' (Le Sushi), a Japanese restaurant in Kaohsiung, by showcasing its diverse menu of donburi, nigiri, and grilled dishes. It uses vibrant close-up food photography and an energetic narration to entice viewers to visit and try their signature items like the seared three-flavor bowl and zucchini beef rolls.
